home.title: Idea Repository

empty.title: No ideas yet
empty.body: Tap + to capture your first idea. Only a name is required.

home.exitBody: Your ideas are saved on this device.

notice.local: Your ideas are stored locally on your device and are not uploaded to our servers.
notice.loss: If you delete the app or change devices, your data may be lost.
notice.backupHint: You can export a backup file from Settings → Backup.

project.name: Project name
project.deleteBody: Its idea notes and resources will be deleted too.
project.tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press space (e.g. AI Mobile)
project.dateWarning: Target end date is earlier than the start date.
project.deleteDetail: {{notes}} note(s) and {{resources}} resource(s) will be deleted too.

category.name: Category name
category.duplicate: A category with this name already exists.
category.deleteUsed: This category is used by {{count}} project(s).

about.tagline: Your ideas. Your device. Yours to build.

note.title: Idea Note
note.placeholder: What came to mind? Notes record how the idea evolves.

resource.title: Title
resource.titlePlaceholder: Auto-filled from the domain if empty

welcome.title: Your ideas stay on your device.
welcome.lead: Idea Repository stores your projects, notes and resources locally on this device. They are not uploaded to our servers — we cannot read them.

point.noAccount: No account, no sign-in. Nothing to register.
point.noCloud: No cloud sync. Your ideas never go to our servers.
point.whatLeaves: What does leave your device: the ad SDK (Google AdMob), a start-up check for notices and updates (app version only), and any support inquiry you choose to send.

gate.updateBody: Please update to the latest version to continue.
gate.updateNoStore: Please update the app from the store.

inquiry.placeholder: Tell us what happened or what you'd like to see.
inquiry.sentBody: Thank you! Your inquiry has been received.
inquiry.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
inquiry.rateLimited: Too many inquiries for now. Please try again tomorrow.
inquiry.offline: You're offline. Please try again when connected.
inquiry.privacyNote: Only your message, the app version and platform are sent. Inquiries are linked to a random ID on this device — no email or name.
inquiry.historyNote: Inquiries are linked to this device. If you delete the app or change devices, past inquiries will no longer appear here.

ideation.title: Idea Lab
ideation.intro: Pick a way to think. Anything you like becomes a project in one tap.

improve.title: Improve
improve.desc: Start from something that exists — add, remove, flip

improve.subject: Something that already exists
improve.answerPlaceholder: Optional — skip if nothing comes up

add.hint: A feature, a step, a person, a place — anything missing.

remove.q: If {{x}} lost one feature, what would you not miss?
remove.hint: Try removing it entirely — what simpler thing is left?

flip.hint: Reverse the order, the roles, or the goal.

reuse.hint: A different situation, place or time of day.

other.hint: What would have to change for them?

who.q: Who else has the same problem?
who.hint: A person, a group, a moment.

how.q: How do people cope with it right now?
how.hint: Workarounds, other apps, or just putting up with it.

words.title: Words
words.intro: {{count}} words in this language. Combine and What if… draw from this list. Built-in words are regular entries — edit or delete any of them.
words.empty: No words yet. Tap + at the top to add one.
words.errorDuplicate: That word is already in the list.

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: Your ideas are stored only on this device. Export them to a file and you can restore them after changing devices or reinstalling the app.
backup.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this device, so the file cannot be exported.
backup.exportFailed: Could not create the backup file. Please try again.
backup.caution: The exported file contains all of your ideas as plain text (not encrypted). Keep it somewhere safe. The file is never sent to our servers.

import.title: Import
import.preview:
This file contains {{projects}} projects, {{notes}} notes, {{resources}} resources, {{categories}} categories, {{tags}} tags and {{words}} Idea Lab words (exported {{exported}}, app {{version}}).

Merge keeps what is on this device and adds or updates from the file. Replace erases everything on this device first.
import.replaceConfirmBody: All projects, notes, resources, categories, tags and Idea Lab words on this device will be deleted and replaced with the file. This cannot be undone.
import.failed: The import could not be completed. Nothing on this device was changed.
import.invalidFile: This is not an Idea Repository backup file, or the file is damaged.
import.newerApp: This file was made with a newer version of the app. Please update the app and try again.

update.title: Update available
update.body: Version {{version}} is available on the store.
